title: SKE Crystal Pro Blue Sour Raspberry Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Designed for use with the SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pods offer a simple and cost-effective way to enjoy exceptional flavour without the waste and expense caused by disposable vapes. Each prefilled pod provides up to 600 puffs, depending on individual usage, and contains 2ml of 20mg nic salt e-liquid, delivering a smooth and satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape with rapid nicotine relief. Blue Sour Raspberry blends the sweet, syrupy notes of Blue Raspberry with a deliciously sour edge. The contrast between rich sweetness and tangy tartness creates a bold and lively vape that keeps each puff exciting, while a crisp, refreshing exhale leaves a clean finish. Swapping pods is quick and effortless—simply remove the empty pod and click a fresh one into place. Whether you're looking for an alternative to disposables or a reliable way to continue enjoying your favourite SKE Crystal Pro 600 flavours, these prefilled pods provide a convenient, mess-free, and satisfying solution.
